paul.docs: Quick company-wide policy update for SDK/docs teams: we're formalizing our minimum deprecation window and the expectations for breaking changes. Posting here so SDK owners and PMs see it.

New rules (summary):
- Minimum deprecation window for any SDK-visible breaking change: 90 days.
- Breaking change must include: migration guide, automated codemod (when feasible), public changelog entry, and a docs banner for the first 30 days after launch.
- SDK releases that remove or rename public parameters require a deprecation alias for the first 90-day window (server-side or client shim).
- All breaking changes must be flagged with the `BREAKING_CHANGE` label on PRs and include a short "user impact" blurb in the PR description.

arya.sdk: Nice. A couple implementation notes from SDK side: we'll ship deprecation aliases where possible, but for some Rust/FFI surface changes a runtime shim isn't trivial. We should allow a documented exception process (eg: security fixes or impossible shims).

paul.docs: Agreed. Exception process: the owning team must open a short RFC in the docs repo (template provided), include the mitigation plan, and get sign-off from Eng Manager + Legal for security-sensitive exceptions. We'll publish exceptions in the policy doc.

nils.eng: For Dedicated/Private customers we also need to document upgrade guidance. I suggest we publish patch images with both old and new endpoints available for the first maintenance window and include a runtime toggle to enforce the new behavior. Ops needs at least 2-week notice for coordination.

legal-bot: Legal review request: any change affecting data collection, privacy-related params, or consent flows must be reviewed before the deprecation is announced. Please ping privacy@. We'll add this to the PR checklist.

ci-bot: We'll add a new linter rule to docs-ci and sdk-ci that ensures PRs with the BREAKING_CHANGE label include the migration checklist file. Planning to land the linter in two weeks.

sara.pm: Product note: can we standardize a short customer-facing paragraph that AMs can copy into their outreach? Something like: "We9re introducing a breaking change to X with a 90-day migration window, here9s the migration guide and contact." If we standardize the template, AMs can move faster.

paul.docs: Yes 1) I'll add a copy template to the policy doc for AMs and release managers. 2) We'll also add a changelog format guideline: short summary + migration link + example code diff.

keith.support: From support: please include a support-runbook entry for major breaking changes so we can triage incoming tickets quickly (keywords to search, likely root causes).

paul.docs: Good call. Action items: 
- [ ] Publish formal policy doc with templates and exception flow (paul)
- [ ] Add BREAKING_CHANGE linter to docs-ci and sdk-ci (ci-bot)
- [ ] SDK teams to plan aliases/shims or file exception RFCs (arya/nils + SDK owners)
- [ ] Add AM copy template and support runbook template (sara/keith)
- [ ] Legal/privacy review step added to PR checklist (legal-bot)

If you own an item, drop a quick :thumbsup: and link your PR/RFC. We'll review policy in the next engineering all-hands. Thanks!
